name: Vostok 1 crewed Earth orbit
description: A human travelled around Earth aboard the Soviet Vostok 1 spacecraft.

date.basis: The cited source dates this scoped episode.

events.statement: Yuri Gagarin orbited Earth aboard the Soviet Vostok 1 spacecraft.
events.caveats: The specific flight does not characterize every subsequent crewed spacecraft.
